name: Lettuce Earth growth · WUR gradient boosting
validation: Leave-one-experiment-out CV (4 outer folds), identical folds for every learner including the baseline. Independent-study validation unavailable.

modelSelection.rule: Same folds and same grouping for every learner. The shipped class must beat the class v1 actually serves on pooled R2 and MAE and on MAE in at least three of the four held-out experiments.
modelSelection.histGradientBoostingNote: HistGradientBoosting scored marginally higher but bins its features and stores structured-array predictors; shipping it would require re-implementing sklearn's binning in the dependency-free evaluator.

interval.caveat: Four experiments. Coverage of 0.961 is over-covered and over-fitted to those four; treat the interval as descriptive of this dataset's spread.

crossCampaign.campaign: Wicharuck et al. 2024, PeerJ 12:e17085 (doi:10.7717/peerj.17085, CC BY 4.0)
crossCampaign.statement: Within the four WUR experiments the 90 % interval covered 0.9606. Against the independent PeerJ 2024 campaign it did not cover any of the 6 independent treatment means (prediction/measurement ratio median 3.212, range 1.674-5.375). The interval therefore describes the fitted campaign and must not be read as a 90 % coverage claim outside it. PeerJ 2024 was already used as a development check before this measurement, so it is a cross-campaign measurement, not an untouched holdout.

limitations: Only Batavia Othilie lettuce on Earth; not calibrated for partial gravity or radiation.
No inference for water stress, nutrient stress, CO2 response, other cultivars, or different photoperiods.
Measured domain is 2-29 days after transplant, air/root 20-32 C, PPFD 200-750 umol/m2/s; the treatment grid is sparse.
Environmental combinations omitted for tip burn are unsupported even inside marginal ranges.
Fresh shoot mass per plant is not edible harvest per square meter; no planting-density conversion is assumed.
Boosted trees extrapolate to a constant outside the training range; the out-of-domain flag is mandatory, not advisory.

uncertainty.caveat: Four experiments. Coverage of 0.961 is over-covered and over-fitted to those four; treat the interval as descriptive of this dataset's spread.

sourceLicense: CC BY 4.0, declared in the dataset's RO-Crate (data/metadata/wur_lettuce_rocrate.json)
sourceCitation: Meinen E., Carotti L., Graamans L., Puksic F., Butturini M., Stanghellini C. (2025). Data underlying the publication: Plant Factories Are Heating Up: Hunting for the Best Combination of Light Intensity, Air Temperature and Root-Zone Temperature in Lettuce Production. 4TU.ResearchData. https://doi.org/10.4121/5a7472f0-8a67-4ec0-84c9-9d032990d654.v1
servedScope: Retrospective interpolation within four WUR plant-factory experiments (cv. Batavia Othilie, 2-29 days after transplant, PPFD 200-750, air and root 20-32 C). An independent check failed: against Wicharuck et al. 2024 (PeerJ 12:e17085, Thai greenhouse, 28 DAT) the model overpredicted by a median 3.2x, range 1.7x-5.4x. The 0.870 leave-one-study-out R2 is interpolation between four experiments, not transfer to a fifth. Cross-campaign coverage was measured: against the independent PeerJ 2024 campaign this model covered 0 of 6 treatment means (ratio median 3.212, range 1.674-5.375).

archivalRecord.served: research surface with the failed independent check stated
archivalRecord.reason: The failed external check is the result. Removing the card would remove the evidence that the platform checked.

note: No operational forecast. This card describes what the model reproduces inside the measured domain; it is not a prediction of a future or unmeasured crop.

evidenceVerdict.reason: 0 of 6 independent treatment means covered, prediction/measurement ratio median 3.212 (1.674-5.375)

checks.criterion: no observation may fall outside a nominal 90 % interval that is offered as a 90 % interval; the study's six treatment means are independent of the fit
checks.detail: 0 of 6 independent treatment means covered, prediction/measurement ratio median 3.212 (1.674-5.375)
